lat: sreft l-flus kamlin f nhar wa7ed
en: I spent all the money in one day.

lat: ma sreftch bezzaf dyal l-flus l-bare7
ar: ما صرفتش بزاف ديال الفلوس البارح
en: I did not spend a lot of money yesterday.

lat: wach srefti kulchi f d-dekkan
en: Did you spend everything in the shop?

lat: nta ma sreftich l-flus dyalk
en: You didn't spend your money.

lat: wach srefti l-flus f s-suq
en: Did you spend the money in the market?

lat: nti ma sreftich bezzaf f l-3utla
en: You didn't spend a lot during the vacation.

lat: huwa sref myat derhem l-yum
en: He spent one hundred dirhams today.

lat: baba ma srefch l-flus dyalu
en: My father did not spend his money.

lat: khti serfat bezzaf f l-mdina
en: My sister spent a lot in the city.

lat: hiya ma serfatch 7ta derhem
en: She didn't spend even one dirham.

lat: 7na srefna kulchi f r-re7la
en: We spent everything on the trip.

lat: ma srefnach bezzaf f l-weqt dyal l-3id
ar: ما صرفناش بزاف فالوقت ديال العيد
en: We didn't spend much at the time of Eid.

lat: wach sreftu l-flus dyal l-kra
en: Did you spend the rent money?

lat: ntuma ma sreftuch walu f l-mghrib
en: You didn't spend anything in Morocco.

lat: d-drari serfu l-flus kamlin f s-sinima
en: The boys spent all the money at the cinema.

lat: huma ma serfuch bezzaf l-bare7
en: They did not spend a lot yesterday.

lat: dima kansref l-flus f l-makla
en: I always spend money on food.

lat: ana ma kansrefch bezzaf f s-sfer
en: I do not spend a lot while traveling.

lat: nta katsref kul lila f l-qehwa
en: You spend money at the cafe every night.

lat: 3lech ma katsrefch 3la rasek
en: Why do you not spend on yourself?

lat: nti dima katserfi l-flus f l-7wayj
en: You always spend money on clothes.

lat: nti ma katserfich bezzaf f l-weqfa
en: You do not spend a lot on the holiday eve.

lat: huwa kaysref bezzaf f d-dar kul chhar
ar: هو كيصرف بزاف فالدار كل شهر
en: He spends a lot on the house every month.

lat: huwa ma kaysrefch l-flus bla fayda
ar: هو ما كيصرفش الفلوس بلا فايدة
en: He does not spend money without purpose.

lat: khti katsref bezzaf 3la d-drari
en: My sister spends a lot on the children.

lat: hiya ma katsrefch 7ta derhem hna
ar: هي ما كتصرفش حتى درهم هنا
en: She does not spend even one dirham here.

lat: 7na kanserfu bezzaf f had ch-chhar
en: We spend a lot this month.

lat: 7na ma kanserfuch l-flus f l-khawi
en: We do not spend money for nothing.

lat: wach katserfu bezzaf dyal l-flus
en: Do you spend a lot of money?

lat: ntuma ma katserfuch walu kul lila
ar: نتوما ما كتصرفوش والو كل ليلة
en: You do not spend anything every night.

lat: huma kayserfu l-flus f s-sfer
en: They spend money on traveling.

lat: huma ma kayserfuch bezzaf f d-dar
en: They do not spend much at home.

lat: ghda ghadi nsref l-flus f s-suq
en: Tomorrow I am going to spend the money in the market.

lat: ana ma ghadich nsref walu l-yum
ar: انا ما غاديش نصرف والو اليوم
en: I am not going to spend anything today.

lat: wach ghadi tsref l-flus dyalk kamlin
ar: واش غادي تصرف الفلوس ديالك كاملين
en: Are you going to spend all your money?

lat: nta ma ghadich tsref bezzaf f tanja
ar: نتا ما غاديش تصرف بزاف فطنجة
en: You are not going to spend a lot in Tangier.

lat: nti ghadi tserfi l-flus f l-3id
en: You are going to spend money at Eid.

lat: nti ma ghadich tserfi 7ta 7aja
ar: نتي ما غاديش تصرفي حتى حاجة
en: You are not going to spend anything.

lat: huwa ghadi ysref l-khalas dyalu ghda
ar: هو غادي يصرف الخلاص ديالو غدا
en: He is going to spend his salary tomorrow.

lat: huwa ma ghadich ysref flus l-bi3
ar: هو ما غاديش يصرف فلوس البيع
en: He is not going to spend the sales money.

lat: hiya ghadi tsref myatayn derhem ghda
ar: هي غادي تصرف مياتين درهم غدا
en: She is going to spend two hundred dirhams tomorrow.

lat: khti ma ghadich tsref flus mmi
ar: ختي ما غاديش تصرف فلوس امي
en: My sister is not going to spend my mother's money.

lat: 7na ghadi nserfu bezzaf f l-3ers
en: We are going to spend a lot on the wedding.

lat: 7na ma ghadich nserfu f l-funduq
en: We are not going to spend in the hotel.

lat: wach ntuma ghadi tserfu l-flus kamlin
ar: واش نتوما غادي تصرفو الفلوس كاملين
en: Are you going to spend all the money?

lat: ntuma ma ghadich tserfu bezzaf daba
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تصرفو بزاف دابا
en: You are not going to spend a lot now.

lat: huma ghadi yserfu bezzaf f r-rbat
en: They are going to spend a lot in Rabat.

lat: ch-chabab ma ghadich yserfu flus bezzaf
ar: الشباب ما غاديش يصرفو فلوس بزاف
en: The young people are not going to spend a lot of money.
